tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rnal 'byor ma'i sngags don la gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i gsung lan bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang sngags oṃ gsum ma'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i gsung sgros ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ nye snying gsungs pa'i mthar/ 'di las shin tu mchog gyur gang / /'jig rten gsum na ci yang med/ /zhes sogs nas/ bklags pas 'di dag thams cad 'grub/ /ces rgyas par gsungs la/ don de dag la dgongs nas/ rje blo gsal rgya mtshos/ he ru ka dpal rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i nye ba'i snying po mchog /bklags pas 'grub ces gsungs pa'i bden pas skyongs/ /zhes gsungs la/ de'i rgyu mtshan bsgrub bya'i yul du gyur pa mkha' 'gro grangs med pa rnams bsdu na bye ba phrag bzhir 'dus/ de yang stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su/ de yang yul chen sum cu so bdun du gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams su/ de yang snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhir/ de yang rdo rje phag mo nyid du 'dus la/ de'i gsang sngags oṃ gsum la'ang rgyud du sbas pa'i don rgyal chen in+d+ra bhu tis phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sngags btur yig 'bru sum cu so gnyis gsungs shing / btu tshul logs na gsal/ de la yig 'bru so gnyis kyis ni yul so gnyis kyis dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi snying po mtshon la/ sa bon baṃ yig la srog yig a thung / ya ra la wa bcas yig 'bru lnga mtshon pas sum cu so bdun 'byung la/ des na yul chen sum cu so bdun gyi dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi snying po yin no/ /de rnams kyang 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis su 'dus pas/ baṃ yig cha lnga pa ni bde chen lha lnga/ oṃ dang po khaṇ+ḍa kā pa li nas/ tsa nī ye yan gyi yig 'bru nyer bzhis dpa' bo nyer bzhi dang dpa' mo nyer bzhi mtshon/ de man gyi yig 'bru brgyad kyis sgo mtshams ma brgyad mtshon no/

/de ltar na gong gi dpa' bo nyer bzhi'i mtshon don ni zla dkyil la byed gsung / 'di ni gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /sngags dang lha la tha dad med/ /ces gsungs pas rnam pa sngags su gsal ba'i dbang du byas la/ lhar bsgom pa'i lus dkyil ni yig chung zur gsal ltar lags/ zhes pa 'di ni rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po'i zhabs 'bring ba dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas oṃ gsum ma'i mtshon don zhig dgos gsungs par chos smra ba'i btsun pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis chos grwa chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs su nye bar bsdus pa zhig bris nas phul ba'i zhu saṃ/ /maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rnal 'byor ma'i sngags don la gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i gsung lan/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
